gaps.explanation: The budgetary comparison schedules (p6 General Fund; pp7-8 Major Funds) print only one net line, 'TOTAL OTHER FINANCING SOURCES (USES)' / 'OTHER FINANCING SOURCES (USES)', per fund; detail recorded these net amounts (idx 39 General -2,640,682 p6; idx 47 Road 2,554,682 p7; idx 51 Inheritance -179,999 p7; idx 58 Equipment Sinking 89,200 p8) under total labels, so they are not counted as transfers. p4 Statement of Cash Receipts, Disbursements, and Changes in Fund Balances - Governmental Funds prints the gross transfers per fund: Transfers in General Fund 3,200, Road Fund 2,554,682, Equipment Sinking Fund 89,200, Nonmajor Funds 191,733 (already in detail per fund: idx 90 Special Road Fund 179,999 + idx 91 Federal Justice Equitable Sharing Fund 11,734), Total 2,838,815; Transfers out General Fund (2,643,882), Inheritance Fund (179,999), Nonmajor (14,934) (already in detail, idx 92 Federal Treasury Equitable Sharing Fund), Total (2,838,815). Fix: replace the four net total-row lines with the gross per-fund transfers from p4 (General net 3,200 - 2,643,882 = -2,640,682; Road 2,554,682; Inheritance -179,999; Equipment Sinking 89,200, so other financing net per fund is unchanged). The removed lines carry total labels and are not part of the transfers schedule_total, so the transfer check is 191,733 + 3,200 + 2,554,682 + 89,200 = 2,838,815 = statement total.
